sittings.bodyEn: Shirt and dark trousers. Not a suit. Not dressed like you are going to code. You are walking into a 总办 conversation today at 18:00.
sittings.mandarin: 衬衫和深色裤子。不是西装。也不穿成像去写代码。今天18:00去见总办。

sittings.bodyEn: Bring the two-page Chinese resume facts, the English two-page as a spare, passport, and the chat thread if the lobby checks the appointment.
sittings.mandarin: 带两页中文简历事实、英文两页备用、护照。前台如果核预约，带和丁先生的聊天记录。

sittings.titleEn: Address and how to address him
sittings.bodyEn: Address 杭州市余杭区洋帆中心1幢21楼. Company 枫翎集团. Call him 丁先生, not 老板, unless he says he is the boss.
sittings.mandarin: 地址杭州市余杭区洋帆中心1幢21楼。公司枫翎集团。称呼丁先生，不要先叫老板，除非他自己说他是老板。

sittings.bodyEn: Intro from chapter 3, then the first four questions. No patents. No funding. Keep the ask short if time is tight.
sittings.mandarin: 先用第三章的自我介绍，再问前四个问题。不谈专利，不谈融资。

sittings.bodyEn: If a sentence sticks, switch briefly, then repeat in Chinese. Do not panic into inventing facts.
sittings.mandarin: 这句我说英文，然后我再用中文说一遍。
